[Unit]
After=network.target
[Service]
User=desk
Environment=DISPLAY=:0
Environment=HTTP_PROXY=http://10.0.2.100:3128
Environment=HTTPS_PROXY=http://10.0.2.100:3128
Environment=http_proxy=http://10.0.2.100:3128
Environment=https_proxy=http://10.0.2.100:3128
ExecStart=/usr/bin/Xvfb :0 -screen 0 1440x900x24 -nolisten tcp -ac
Restart=on-failure
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
After=talos-screen.service
[Service]
User=desk
Environment=DISPLAY=:0
Environment=HTTP_PROXY=http://10.0.2.100:3128
Environment=HTTPS_PROXY=http://10.0.2.100:3128
Environment=http_proxy=http://10.0.2.100:3128
Environment=https_proxy=http://10.0.2.100:3128
ExecStart=/usr/bin/dbus-run-session -- /usr/bin/xfce4-session
Restart=on-failure
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
After=talos-screen.service
[Service]
User=desk
Environment=DISPLAY=:0
Environment=HTTP_PROXY=http://10.0.2.100:3128
Environment=HTTPS_PROXY=http://10.0.2.100:3128
Environment=http_proxy=http://10.0.2.100:3128
Environment=https_proxy=http://10.0.2.100:3128
ExecStart=/usr/bin/x11vnc -display :0 -forever -shared -rfbport 5900 -nopw -quiet
Restart=on-failure
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

PasswordAuthentication no
PermitRootLogin prohibit-password
AllowUsers root desk
AllowTcpForwarding no
X11Forwarding no
PermitTunnel no

[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Talos Computer
Exec=chromium --start-maximized --proxy-server=http://10.0.2.100:3128 --no-first-run --disable-sync --disable-background-networking --password-store=basic file:///opt/talos/welcome.html

TALOS COMPUTER

A place to turn
ideas into work.

Your browser, terminal and project files, together in one persistent workspace.

Projects live in ~/Projects.
Take over whenever you need to.

Your machine. Your work. Your control.
